title: Classify Status Codes
story: Retry on 5xx, give up on 4xx. First, name the class of a code.
goal: Write classify(code) returning "ok", "client error" or "server error".
hints: Return "ok" for 2xx first, then check 4xx, then 5xx.
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Classify Status Codes”?
